question: Pandit Ravi Shankar is known worldwide for playing which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sitar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was a legendary Indian musician and composer, known for his profound influence on the world of music.
 
• He played the **Sitar**, a plucked stringed instrument used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• Ravi Shankar's performances and collaborations helped popularize the sitar and Indian classical music globally.
 
• He trained under **Ustad Allauddin Khan** and was associated with several international artists, including George Harrison of The Beatles.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Mohan Veena
 The Mohan Veena is a modified slide guitar used in Indian classical music, popularized by Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt.
 
 

 Option 2: Sarod
 The Sarod is another stringed instrument used in Indian classical music, known for its deep, weighty, introspective sound.
 
 

 Option 3: Been
 The Been, also known as the Rudra Veena, is an ancient Indian plucked string instrument, mainly used in Hindustani classical music.
